verdict.rationale: gstack's documentation is largely written for agents to read. It ships an agents-digest/gstack-AGENTS.md file that compresses its behavioral rules "for agent hosts without a full skill install" (gstack-docs-47), and its SKILL.md files are markdown that agents read directly from disk, including a router SKILL.md (gstack-docs-18, gstack-docs-50, gstack-docs-41). Missing for 10: no llms.txt file is evidenced, the probe for a markdown docs page returned 404 (gstack-probe-1), and no independent corroboration exists of agents consuming the AGENTS.md digest.
